component.name: Legion Light
component.summary: Keyboard backlight control for Lenovo Legion laptops

description.p: Legion Light sets the keyboard backlight colour, brightness and effect on Lenovo Legion laptops with a one-zone RGB keyboard, and edits the three lighting profiles that Fn+Space cycles through.
Static, Breathe and Lenovo colour effects run in the keyboard firmware and keep working after the app exits. Custom palettes fade through two to four colours while the app is running.
Device access needs a udev rule installed on the host; see the project page.
